column1: # What the differential test compares, and where each file came from.
# Columns: role, source (commit:path, or the path in this repo), sha256 of the bytes.
# v0.1.0 (commit 43d4368, tag object 6ea8153) is the newest published build and the only one. The
# repo publishes v* releases only, no dev pre-release, and no predecessor repo shipped this mod. It
# pinned core d992124. src/config.cpp, src/config.h, src/config_sanitize.h and src/logging.h are byte
# for byte the same at v0.1.0 and at d9e4044, the commit the reader was frozen at, and every core
# source either reader compiles holds the same bytes at d992124 and at the current pin, so
# v0.1.0's release ZIP and launcher-manifest.json shipped no HeadTracking.ini and seeded none: its
# first start wrote it from kDefaultIniText in src/config.cpp. That text, extracted once, is the
# first-run input. The repo's HeadTracking.ini has one committed version, a7c58a1, unchanged
# through v0.1.0, and it holds the same bytes, so it is the same input.

column2: kDefaultIniText at v0.1.0, what its first start wrote, and a7c58a1:HeadTracking.ini: data/firstrun-v0.1.0.ini
